author: claude:factory
source_detail: The third instrument for the starter signal. KXMLBOUTS settles on how many outs the starter records: 435 markets on tape, 93 percent two-sided, 1.87c bar, 500 at the ask.
thesis: A pitcher whose recent form is much worse than his season line gets pulled earlier, and a market on how long he lasts is a more direct read on that than a market on who wins. It is the same claim as the starter bot's, aimed at the outcome the claim is actually about.

entry.when: Identical trigger and coefficients to the live starter bot. When the divergence is against the pitcher, take the under on his outs; when it favours him, the over. ASSUMPTION, STATED: 1.00 ER/9 of divergence is worth about 0.6 outs, because a run of expected damage is roughly a fifth of an inning of leash. Enter when net edge after the real ask and the half fee is at least 1.0c.

wrong_if: No better than starter on shared games.
The outs line moves on the manager's plan rather than on form, i.e. the entries cluster on pitch-limited returns from injury.
The 0.6-outs-per-ER9 conversion changes the sign of the result when set to 0.3 or 1.0.
notes: PAIRED-TESTABLE against starter, third instrument alongside SF200. || RANKED BELOW SF200 ON PURPOSE: same information, thinner market (500 at the ask against 1,449) and a higher bar (1.87c against 1.37c). If only one starter-instrument slot is available, SF200 is the one to take. || Cost bar and ask depth are MEASURED off this project's own recorded tape, not assumed - src/mlb_cost.py, median over every two-sided touch recorded 2026-08-18 to 2026-09-03 between 5c and 95c, with the fee taken at that series' own rate from the census. Both sides of the real touch, never the mid. || Exit is HOLD TO SETTLEMENT on every spec here, deliberately. Mailbox 012: tennis measured exits properly and holding beat selling early in 5 of 5 mentalities, and mlb's own 81-configuration sweep had every stop-loss doing worse than holding. So the exit question is closed and nothing below varies it. These are ENTRY specs only.
